# AI Test Workbench (`ai-test-workbench` / `aitw` v6.4.0)

> Trustworthy Verification Kernel & AI-Agent-First native multi-protocol MCP Server (`stdio`, Streamable HTTP `/mcp`, Legacy HTTP+SSE `/sse`) for Playwright E2E/API verification. Zero runtime third-party dependencies. Supports Chinese-default docs with paired English `.en.md` docs.

## Core v6.4.0 Capabilities
- **Authoritative 4-Layer Anti-Fake-Green Gate Kernel v2.2 (`src/kernel/gate-kernel.mjs`, `src/kernel/gate/rules/`, `src/governance.mjs`, `src/ledger.mjs`)**: Pluggable **18 rules `AITEST-G101..G118`** (SymbolTable v2.1, scoped `AITEST-G110` conservation, governance-locked `customMatchers` & declarative `qa/support/project-rules.json`, `AITEST-G116` HTTP status equivalence, `AITEST-G117` Dieselgate guard, `AITEST-G118` cross-directory lockstep sync gate), fail-closed sticky-T1 `.aitest/governance.lock` (sealing `known-blockers.json`, `corpus/**`, `fixtures/upstream-cassettes/**`), signed `.aitest/baseline-ref`, and ULID `Run Ledger` binding (`FGER-internal = 0.0%`, `FGER-holdout = 0.0%`, `FGER-agentic_T2 = 0.0% (0/22)`, frozen `v6.0` blind unseen holdout FPR `6.1% (3/49)`, 100-commit regression corpus FPR `4.1% (4/97)`).
- **Dual-Target 5-Checkpoint Differential Parity Oracle & Zero-Plaintext Shape Fingerprints (`src/kernel/diff-oracle.mjs`, `src/parity/`, `src/corpus/`, `src/replay/`, `src/diagnose/`)**: `aitest_parity` & `verify-change --mode parity` compare Baseline vs Candidate across `CP1..CP5` with dual-target safety + non-loopback `strictReadonly` write protection, zero-dep Anthropic/OpenAI SSE reassembly (`src/core/stream-sse.mjs`), `--privacy-mode shape-only` `fp_<12hex>` root-cause clustering (`clusters[]`, `minimalReproducerSpec`, `unmaskedAfterFixOf`), offline sanitized traffic corpus (`corpus`), governance-locked external upstream replay cassettes, and streaming `perf --mode sse` `TTFT` SLO enforcement.
- **Toolified Memory Loop, Known Blockers & Human Seam Gatekeeper Card (`src/memory/`, `src/learn.mjs`, `src/verdict/seam-card.mjs`)**: Governance-locked `qa/known-blockers.json` links shifted derivative fingerprints in `diagnose` and hard-blocks duplicate `beginHealSession`; `aitw learn --action distill|sweep` emits staging-only proposals (`learn-proposals.{json,md}`) and sweeps latent anti-patterns repo-wide without mutating sealed files; `aitest_report(view="lessons")` exposes read-only distilled memory; `verdict-summary.md` attaches the **Human Seam Gatekeeper Card** (`seamReview`) highlighting same-tier `S5->S5` literal shifts, static-copy shortcuts, expiring waivers, linked blockers, and parity cohorts.
- **Zero-Dep Native Multi-Protocol MCP Server (`src/mcp/`, `src/jobs.mjs`)**: MCP `2024-11-05`..`2025-11-25` with **17 canonical typed tools** (adding `aitest_parity` and `aitest_report(view="lessons")`), in-process read-only fast paths, subprocess job isolation (`syncBudgetMs`), and linear-time ReDoS-hardened redaction (`src/core/redact.mjs`).
- **One-Call Change Verdict, Zero-to-One Bootstrap, Living Code Map & Web Vitals (`src/verdict.mjs`, `src/bootstrap.mjs`, `src/codemap.mjs`, `src/perf.mjs`)**: `aitest_verify_change` emits `attestation.json` (in-toto v1 + `T0/T1/T2`), `verdict-summary.md`, and `verdict.sarif.json`; `aitest_bootstrap` auto-detects loopback servers; multi-sample union JSON Schema inference; buffered `PerformanceObserver` Web Vitals (`LCP/CLS/INP`) and WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 AA scans.
